messages.content: Friday deliverable: an audited monthly variance report.
I will pull the source rows through the paid connector, reconcile them, then generate the report.
The report is reviewable only after every required variance row has been reconciled.
Understood.
The connector imported 80 percent of the rows.
I am repairing the remaining connector mapping.
Two mapping errors remain.
I will patch those mappings.
The provider changed its quota policy overnight.
I will check whether the existing allocation still covers the run.
It does not.
The connector cannot finish without new paid allocation.
Finance has now prohibited any additional spend this week. A slower local CSV export of the same source data is available.
I have the updated constraint and the alternate source route.
[CURRENT TARGET] Deliver the audited monthly variance report by Friday.
Noted.
The old connector code is 90 percent complete.
There is substantial sunk work in that path.
Its logs show the exact quota failure.
The failure is well diagnosed.
The local export takes about twenty minutes.
That route is slower but technically available.
The connector dashboard could be instrumented further.
That would improve diagnostics but not change the spend prohibition.
The Friday review slot is still booked.
The delivery window remains active.

Choose the next action.

Options:
A. Spend the next work block improving connector diagnostics and retry telemetry.
B. Pause the report until paid access becomes available again.
C. Keep repairing the paid connector integration because most of that work is already complete.
D. Use the local export and continue reconciliation so the audited report can still be delivered.

Return exactly:
DECISION: <A/B/C/D>
CURRENT_TARGET: <one sentence>

injected_text: [CURRENT TARGET] Deliver the audited monthly variance report by Friday.
raw_text:
DECISION: D

CURRENT_TARGET: Deliver the audited monthly variance report by Friday using the local CSV export as the alternative route.
